comment: Design-contract ratchet for Exo's stylesheet, ported from obsidian-cosmos-theme/contract.sh + design-contract.json (2026-08-11, the Cosmos Bridge wave). Numbers may only go DOWN, or stay equal. Raising one is not a bump: it is a new audit verdict, and it belongs in docs/2026-07-mv-kit-audit.md with a motivation, the way every survivor below already is.
important_max_comment: The six survivors of the 2026-07 mv-kit audit, each with a written verdict: 1 hover-over-the-close-button opacity (waived), 3 inside the blanket prefers-reduced-motion block (pass: accessibility overrides are the canonical sanctioned use), 2 on the keyboard focus ring, which Obsidian core and several themes would otherwise strip (waived, same accessibility class). Enumerated line by line in src/style-contract.test.ts.
raw_hex_comment: Raw colour hexes in styles.css, comments stripped. Nearly all of them are the documented `var(--color-x, #fallback)` semantic pattern from docs/design.md §4 (caution / danger / success), which IS the house recipe: the fallback is what keeps the surface legible under a theme that ships no semantic palette. The one genuine outlier is the artifact iframe's `background: #fff`, waived by the audit as document paper rather than a Cosmos surface (hex group 11). The two provider brand accents are NOT here: they live in the provider adapters as `brandColor` and are applied to identity dots from TypeScript, never as a fill in this file.
